title: The Impact of Education on Chronic Disease Risk
research_question: Does the level of education attained influence the likelihood of developing chronic diseases later in life? This study explores the causal relationship between education and chronic disease incidence, using quarter-of-birth as an instrumental variable to address potential endogeneity in educational attainment.
data_description: The dataset comprises 500 individuals, including variables such as 'y' (indicator for chronic disease), 'x' (years of education), 'z' (quarter-of-birth as an instrument), and 'controls' (demographic and socioeconomic factors).
